label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y si minjá sobre la plancha tu ofrenda, sólet amasada en el aceite, ázima será.
spanish: Y si oblación sobre la plancha tu ofrenda, harina fina mezclada en el aceite, ázima será.
grammarChanges: Replaced transliteration 'minjá' with Spanish 'oblación' for H4503 (noun common feminine singular absolute).
Replaced transliteration 'sólet' with Spanish 'harina fina' for H5560 (noun common feminine singular absolute).
Replaced 'amasada' with 'mezclada' for H1101 (qal passive participle of mix/mingle), matching the lemma sense without adding kneading.
readerNote: Minjá is rendered oblación, not ofrenda, so it stays distinct from קרבן/tu ofrenda in the same verse.
